title: Split orchestrator turn loop responsibilities
description:
Refactor orchestrator turn execution so context assembly, model/tool loop, transcript persistence, trace projection, and scene-close handling are not all concentrated in one file.

Preserve the existing transactional/savepoint safety behavior.
acceptance_criteria:
- Turn-running logic is separated from model/tool loop mechanics.
- Trace projection is isolated.
- Scene transcript/logging behavior is isolated.
- Scene-close/summarization hooks are isolated.
- Transaction/savepoint rollback behavior is preserved.
- Existing orchestrator tests pass.
notes: PR #78 opened: https://github.com/jbongaarts/loreweaver/pull/78 — refactor splits orchestrator.ts into turnLoop, turnTraceProjection, turnTranscript, turnSceneSummary modules; SAVEPOINT semantics preserved; all tests pass.
